name: CA-24
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Carbajal with large cash advantage ($3.4M vs $47K)
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Carbajal: a D+13 district, incumbency, and a dominant fundraising edge over Bob Smith. Prediction markets price his win at roughly 98%, consistent with a Safe D rating despite the absence of polls.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a much tighter race or unexpected outside spending against Carbajal would warrant revisiting.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Salud Carbajal seeks another term in a central coast district that leans Democratic by about 13 points. He enters the general with a decisive financial advantage, holding $3.4 million on hand after raising $1.65 million, while Republican Bob Smith has raised about $203,000 with only $47,000 remaining. No outside groups have meaningfully engaged in the race.

No public general-election polls are available, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, incumbency, and money, all of which favor Carbajal heavily. Prediction markets price his reelection at roughly 98 percent. The race is rated Safe Democratic, with the main caveat being the lack of direct polling to confirm the fundamentals.
